'''ZXK-100346.6a''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[ZXK-100346 system/Legends|ZXK-100346 system]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was the sixth planet in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] and had a very cold climate that resulted in it being covered in [[Water/Legends|ice]]. Due to its remote location, ancient [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] traveled to the planet to hide the [[Soulsaber]], a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] device. They constructed the [[Cavern of Light]] and placed the artifact there. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]] traveled to the planet in order to steal the Soulsaber. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] fighters battled him there, but he was able to flee with it.
